Probe: test.sh:48 probes 127.0.0.1:3000/api/health then /; integration.md:3 requires GET /api/health 200 even if DB fails. Deps: NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules; express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 installed globally in both environment/Dockerfile:9-12 and tests/Dockerfile:16-21 with the same node:22-bookworm-slim runtime, as integration.md:3 states. Symlink refusal (test.sh:72-83) is stated in integration.md:5 ('don't put symbolic links anywhere in /app; we won't run an app that has them'), and the brief is stricter than the check, so a conforming app is never refused. Restart helper (l.160-167) reuses the identical env/entry/DB. Accounts/password (app_context.md) are in seed_data.json accounts and walls-and-retention.md:3; sign-in surface is a known false positive per the workbook annotation. No same-origin requirement; network public. Corroboration: raw-evidence-index scripted golden ran the frozen solve.sh app as uid 65534 with env -i, DB_PATH and cwd /tmp; I re-verified server.js, solve.sh and seed hashes match the frozen bytes. Weak/alternative apps tried: an app resolving seed or public/ via process.cwd() fails, but the brief explicitly forbids that; an app ignoring DB_PATH still works because DB_PATH defaults to /app/app.db unless /app is unwritable after test.sh chowns it. Notes (non-blocking): (1) the 30 s readiness window (test.sh:116-122) is not stated, but a conforming Express+SQLite seed import starts well within it; (2) the brief does not explicitly say that extra global npm installs made in the agent container are not carried over (only /app and /assets are artifacts); 'The finished app goes in /app' and the stated globally-provided set make the reasonable reading clear.
